The '''IBT-2921''', also known as the '''Imperial blockade truck''',<ref name="SecondEdition" /> was used by the [[Galactic Empire]] as a [[transport]] and mobile weapons platform. The [[repulsorcraft]] was armed with a [[blaster cannon]] that could swivel, and the vehicle could be [[Pilot|driven]] by one individual.<ref name="Rix Road" />

==History==
[[File:Imperial-armored-transport-vehicle.png|thumb|left|250px|An IBT-2921 on Ferrix]]
At least two IBT-2921s were deployed with the [[Ferrix]] [[Ferrix garrison|garrison]] when the world fell under [[Ferrix occupation|Imperial occupation]]. During the [[Ferrix Riot|uprising against the Imperial forces on Ferrix]], one of these vehicles was badly damaged by a [[bomb]] thrown by [[Wilmon Paak]].<ref name="Rix Road" />

In [[4 BBY]],<ref>"[[One Year Later]]" dates the first arc of [[Andor Season 2|''Andor'' Season 2]], including "[[Sagrona Teema]]," to [[4 BBY]].</ref> a pair of these vehicles were used by Imperial forces on [[Mina-Rau]].<ref>{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}}</ref> They were later used again during the [[Ghorman Massacre]] in [[2 BBY]].
